meta_description: 380 likes, 19 comments - lonelyplanet on October 20, 2026: "“You are witnessing part of Earth’s history,” says Lonely Planet Correspondent @tonatiuhhigareda, who went to Mexico’s Yucatán Peninsula to explore Chicxulub Beach, near where the asteroid that wiped out the dinosaurs struck, and the Ring of Cenotes that formed in its aftermath. Tonatiuh grew up swimming in these cenotes and hearing stories of dinosaurs, Mayan gods and mythical “aluxes” believed to protect the land. Want to experience millions of years of history yourself? He suggests visiting between November-March, which may be peak season but typically has less rain and cooler temps.".
